automation_objective: Identify, warm up, qualify, and convert high-quality student candidates from LinkedIn into clstr.in Campus Ambassadors or Marketing Team members.

hard_rules: Do not pitch role before profile evaluation
Do not send role offer in first message
Always run discovery before role pitch
Always verify current college and year in discovery
Always verify college edu email availability before close
Never include owner contact details (WhatsApp/email) in s1_casual_opener, s2_discovery, or s3_role_pitch
Only include owner contact details in s4_close_and_convert
Always include one profile-specific proof point in pitch
Always close with owner contact plus application link

campus_ambassador.summary: College-level growth operator for community activation and peer onboarding.
responsibilities: Build and grow clstr.in student community in campus
Run activations, campaigns, and campus events
Connect students with alumni and opportunities

marketing_team_member.summary: Central growth team member driving outreach, campaigns, and measurable acquisition.
responsibilities: Track funnel metrics and optimize conversion
Coordinate with ambassadors for college growth loops

dimensions.guide: Club roles, coordinator positions, campus visibility
Peer engagement and influence in college circles
Measured participation or outcomes in candidate's college

normalization.notes: When using 5 dimensions, normalize raw /25 score to /20 before banding

context_memory_gate.rule: Before generating any reply, fetch latest candidate context from backend and append last 10 conversation events.

enforcement.contact_sharing_gate: Allow owner contact details only in s4_close_and_convert

stages.goal: Find high-potential profiles and complete capability + engagement scoring
Understand interests, bandwidth, current college status, and edu email readiness
Pitch correct role with personalized upside
Share link + contact and secure commitment

message_templates.casual_opener: Hey {first_name}, saw your work at {college_name} — you're clearly active in building your campus community. I'm building clstr.in — India's verified campus network where students connect with batchmates, alumni mentors, events, and real opportunities in one place. We're bringing on strong campus leaders to shape how this rolls out across colleges. It'd be great to have you as an early voice from {college_name} — what's one thing students there struggle with the most right now?
message_templates.discovery_prompt: That is useful context. Quick check so I can map fit correctly: which college and year are you currently in, and can you use your college email ID for platform onboarding? We are currently onboarding only 2nd and 3rd year students. Also, what kind of work do you enjoy more right now - community building, marketing campaigns, or team leadership?
message_templates.discovery_followup_commitment: Perfect. Last check before role mapping: how many hours can you commit weekly for the next 8 weeks, and what is one campus activity you have executed recently?
message_templates.role_pitch_campus_ambassador: Based on your profile, you look strong for a Campus Ambassador leadership track at clstr.in. This is not passive promotion. You would own campus activations, student onboarding, and community momentum in your college with measurable outcomes.
message_templates.role_pitch_marketing_team: Based on your profile, you are a better fit for the core Marketing Team at clstr.in. You would own campaign execution, outreach systems, and growth metrics with direct responsibility for results.
message_templates.role_pitch_high_hype_personalized: {first_name}, one thing that stands out from your profile is {specific_signal}. That kind of execution and network strength is exactly what we need at clstr.in. If you are open, I want to offer you a role where you own outcomes, not just tasks.
message_templates.close_message: Great. Let us move forward. Fill this quick form and we will fast-track your review: https://forms.gle/2NYjiunqeUk3WUDh9 — takes 2 minutes. You can also reach me on WhatsApp: 9441467303 if you have questions before submitting.
message_templates.follow_up_day_2: Quick nudge, {first_name}. Wanted to check if you saw my note. I think your profile fits what we are building at clstr.in.
message_templates.follow_up_day_5: Last follow-up from my side, {first_name}. If now is not the right time, no problem. If you want to build seriously with clstr.in, I can share next steps today.

hype_guidelines: Tie praise to observed profile signals
Avoid fake urgency and exaggerated claims
Keep tone founder-level, direct, and respectful

qualification_questions: Are you currently enrolled in a college?
What is your college name and current year?
Can you use your college edu email ID for onboarding?
What is one thing you have executed end-to-end in your campus or community?
What outcome did that produce (participation, signups, reach, or other measurable result)?
How many hours can you commit weekly for the next 8 weeks?
Which role do you want: Campus Ambassador or Marketing Team?

nurture_if: intent positive but execution proof limited

backend_context_persistence.objective: Persist candidate context after every message read and every message sent so future replies are context-aware.
safety_rules: If backend write fails, mark candidate state as sync_pending.
Do not send role pitch if latest inbound message not persisted.
Do not send close message if selected_role is missing in context.
Block message send if outbound template contains owner contact details before s4_close_and_convert.

truthfulness: Do not promise fixed pay if not approved
Do not promise equity unless authorized
